propositions: The rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded in _step0_names() and covers only four transport modules, leaving eight other adapters/jira/*.py modules unswept despite potentially containing classified mutating names.
A classified mutating method can be renamed or moved into an unswept module without detection, violating the completeness assertion and leaving rate-limit policy surface unguarded.

Option B implements an anti-drift guard that scans unswept modules for name collisions with _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING and accepts only pure same-name self.transport delegations (backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment are the only current benign collisions).
The anti-drift guard must reject any collision that is not a pure delegation — rejects guards, retries, logging, argument transforms, or any extra statement.

The transport sweep's scope remains explicitly bounded to four declared modules (preserved from ticket 8a5e); a package-wide glob was rejected because it would widen the sweep's subject from transport surface to entire package and require 90 policy judgements.
